1970-02-07: Kentucky Wildcats routed Mississippi 120–85. Dan Issel led the winners with 53 points. Duaine Boucher had 19 for Mississippi. Dan Issel grabbed 19 rebounds.
2001-03-11: Behind Tayshaun Prince's 26 points, Kentucky Wildcats rolled past Mississippi 77–55. Jason Harrison had 12 for Mississippi.
2013-01-29: Kentucky Wildcats beat Mississippi 87–74 as Kyle Wiltjer scored a team-high 26. LaDarius White had 22 for Mississippi.
2025-02-04: Mississippi beat Kentucky Wildcats 98–84 as Matthew Murrell scored a team-high 24. Otega Oweh had 24 for Kentucky Wildcats.
1996-01-06: Kentucky Wildcats blew out Mississippi 90–60 as Tony Delk scored a team-high 14. Ansu Sesay had 16 for Mississippi.
